session_level_turns.assistant_response:
**BEST TIMING:**

**February (Peak):** **Sapporo Snow Festival** - massive ice sculptures transform the city. Odori Park becomes winter wonderland, Susukino Ice World at full scale. Cold but magical.

**May-June:** Perfect weather (15-20°C), **cherry blossoms** at Maruyama Park, fewer crowds than mainland Japan's sakura season.

**July-August:** Warmest (20-25°C), **Susukino Festival** street celebrations, outdoor onsen most comfortable.

**October:** **Autumn foliage** in Jozankei, crisp air perfect for Mount Moiwa views, fewer tourists.

**MAJOR FESTIVALS:**
• **Sapporo Snow Festival** (early Feb) - 2 million visitors, book early
• **YOSAKOI Soran Festival** (June) - massive dance festival unique to Hokkaido
• **Susukino Festival** (July) - street food and summer matsuri

**MY RECOMMENDATION:** **Early June** - perfect weather, post-sakura bloom, pre-summer crowds, and you'll catch late cherry blossoms while enjoying comfortable onsen temperatures.

**Avoid:** March (muddy snow melt) and January (too cold for outdoor activities).
